description:
Ranking of CabalSpy ID verified traders by their tracked trades: volume,
    realized PnL, win rate and trade count for a period. Covers the users of YOUR
    CabalSpy ID instance (the people who signed in on your platform);
    scope='global' ranks every CabalSpy ID user and needs the Enterprise plan.
    Use for "Who are the best traders on my platform this week?". For KOLs and
    smart money tracked by CabalSpy use get_leaderboard.

    Needs your own CabalSpy API key with a CabalSpy ID instance (no demo).

blockchain.description: Blockchain. One of: solana, bnb, base, eth, rh. solana has kol, smart and whale wallets; bnb, base, eth and rh have kol and smart. rh is Robinhood Chain, an Ethereum L2.
blockchain.title: Blockchain

cursor.description: Pagination cursor taken from the previous response. Leave empty for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

instance.description: Your CabalSpy ID instance (its client_id, e.g. 'csid_1a2b…'). Only needed when your account has several instances. Leave empty otherwise.
instance.title: Instance

period.description: Statistics window: 6h, 1d, 7d or 30d. Longer windows return far more data and get trimmed harder, so prefer the shortest window that answers the question.
period.title: Period

scope.description: 'instance' (default): the users of your CabalSpy ID instance. 'global': every CabalSpy ID user, Enterprise plan only.
scope.title: Scope

sort.description: volume (default), pnl (native currency), pnl_usd, win_rate or trades.
sort.title: Sort

name: csid_leaderboard
